---
title: "ShinyGO comparison"
author: "Daniel Gregory"
format: html
editor: visual
---

Compare the ShinyGO pathway results of two runs, e.g. male vs female or under 60 vs over 60. Each run was analysed separately from the start (`subgroup` setting in `deseq2-analysis.qmd`).

# Settings

```{r}
out_dir <- "results/shinygo/output"
group_a <- "Brain_Cortex_vs_Whole_Blood_over60" # goes on the x-axis. Comparison + subgroup, as in the file names
group_b <- "Brain_Cortex_vs_Whole_Blood_under60" # goes on the y-axis
gene_list <- "lfc0-1.5_bm100_both" # band + direction, as in the file name
database <- "GOBP" # KEGG, GOBP, GOCC, GOMF

fdr_cutoff <- 0.05
n_show <- 20 # pathways to list in each table
```

# Load both results

A pathway missing from one file was not close to significant in that run.

```{r}
read_go <- function(group) {
  go <- read.csv(file.path(out_dir, paste0("shinygo_", group, "_", gene_list, "_", database, "_all.csv")), check.names = FALSE)
  go$Pathway <- trimws(sub("^(Path:hsa[0-9]+|GO:[0-9]+) ", "", go$Pathway)) # drop the ID in front of the name
  data.frame(Pathway = go$Pathway, fdr = go$`Enrichment FDR`, fold = go$`Fold Enrichment`, n = go$nGenes)
}

both <- merge(read_go(group_a), read_go(group_b), by = "Pathway", all = TRUE, suffixes = c("_a", "_b"))
both$sig_a <- !is.na(both$fdr_a) & both$fdr_a < fdr_cutoff
both$sig_b <- !is.na(both$fdr_b) & both$fdr_b < fdr_cutoff
both <- both[both$sig_a | both$sig_b, ] # significant in at least one
```

# How many pathways are shared

```{r}
c(both = sum(both$sig_a & both$sig_b), only_x_axis_group = sum(both$sig_a & !both$sig_b), only_y_axis_group = sum(!both$sig_a & both$sig_b))
```

# Fold enrichment, x-axis group vs y-axis group

Each point is a pathway significant in at least one group. Points on the line are equally enriched in both.

Open circles along the left or bottom edge are pathways that are missing from the other group's file (i.e. not significant in that group).

```{r}
col <- ifelse(both$sig_a & both$sig_b, "black", ifelse(both$sig_a, "red", "blue"))
missing <- is.na(both$fold_a) | is.na(both$fold_b)
edge <- min(c(both$fold_a, both$fold_b), na.rm = TRUE) - 0.1 # where the missing ones are drawn
x <- ifelse(is.na(both$fold_a), edge, both$fold_a)
y <- ifelse(is.na(both$fold_b), edge, both$fold_b)

plot(x, y, pch = ifelse(missing, 1, 19), cex = 0.6, col = col, xlab = paste("Fold enrichment,", group_a), ylab = paste("Fold enrichment,", group_b), main = paste(gene_list, database))
abline(0, 1)
legend("bottomright", bty = "n", pch = c(19, 19, 19, 1), col = c("black", "red", "blue", "grey40"),
       legend = c(paste0("both (", sum(both$sig_a & both$sig_b), ")"), paste0("only x-axis group (", sum(both$sig_a & !both$sig_b), ")"),
                  paste0("only y-axis group (", sum(!both$sig_a & both$sig_b), ")"), paste0("not found in the other group (", sum(missing), ")")))
```

# Pathways significant in only one group

```{r}
show <- function(x, by) head(x[order(x[[by]]), c("Pathway", "fdr_a", "fold_a", "fdr_b", "fold_b")], n_show)
show(both[both$sig_a & !both$sig_b, ], "fdr_a") # only the x-axis group
show(both[!both$sig_a & both$sig_b, ], "fdr_b") # only the y-axis group
```

# Pathways significant in both

```{r}
show(both[both$sig_a & both$sig_b, ], "fdr_a")
```
